records.name: Ferritin protein cage
records.scientific_description: Ferritin provides a hollow protein shell for iron storage.
records.design_instructions: Plan an intact sphere and a cutaway of the same shell. Keep the cavity, shell and optional iron-core overlay separately addressable. Use a cage silhouette rather than the open tunnel of a chaperonin; do not prescribe atomic surface detail.
records.scientific_caveat: A schematic shell does not establish a species-specific subunit composition. Resolve an exact structure before showing numbered subunits.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: ring-shaped protein complex and chaperonin barrel; neither is a closed storage cage.

evidence.location: Storing Iron; Transferrin and transferrin receptor

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: ring-shaped protein complex and chaperonin barrel; neither is a closed storage cage.

records.name: Fibrinogen monomer
records.scientific_description: Soluble fibrinogen is cleaved to produce fibrin, which can assemble into fibers.
records.design_instructions: Use an elongated molecule with a central region and two distal lobes connected by slender arms. Provide removable cleavage-site annotations and end attachment points so copies can later form a fiber. Keep the soluble precursor separate from the assembled network.
records.scientific_caveat: Flexible regions are not completely resolved in many structures. Avoid treating the drawing as exact molecular geometry.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: fibrin fiber, which represents the polymer rather than soluble precursor.

evidence.location: Building a Scab; Flexible Fibrin; assembly discussion

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: fibrin fiber, which represents the polymer rather than soluble precursor.

records.name: Lipopolysaccharide molecule
records.scientific_description: LPS connects a lipid anchor to carbohydrate regions on Gram-negative bacterial surfaces.
records.design_instructions: Provide a lipid-anchor module beneath an editable sugar-chain region. Mark membrane insertion and extracellular chain endpoints. Offer schematic short-chain and extended-chain states with strain identity left unset.
records.scientific_caveat: Do not infer a fixed sugar sequence, tail count or universal O-antigen length from a generic LPS symbol.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: glycocalyx and phospholipid; a single LPS building block has a distinct composite molecular architecture.

evidence.location: Introduction; Lipid Carrier

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: glycocalyx and phospholipid; a single LPS building block has a distinct composite molecular architecture.

records.name: IgE Fc domain module
records.scientific_description: IgE Fc contains a C-epsilon-2 domain pair and can adopt a bent configuration distinct from IgG Fc.
records.design_instructions: Design an Fc-only module with paired domain regions and two Fab attachment anchors. Preserve a bent silhouette and expose the receptor-binding side. Full IgE must later reuse two library Fab fragments with this module.
records.scientific_caveat: The cited structure contains Fc, not complete IgE; it does not establish the bound whole-antibody geometry.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: antibody Fc fragment and generic IgG antibody; do not relabel IgG Fc as structurally detailed IgE.

evidence.location: Primary Citation abstract

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: antibody Fc fragment and generic IgG antibody; do not relabel IgG Fc as structurally detailed IgE.

records.name: Bacterial porin beta-barrel
records.scientific_description: Classical porins provide water-filled diffusion paths through the bacterial outer membrane.
records.design_instructions: Plan a short membrane-spanning barrel with a visible lumen and rim loops. Supply side and axial views with separate lumen and membrane anchors. Assemble oligomers from instances; label the selected porin before giving an oligomer count.
records.scientific_caveat: Porins vary in selectivity and oligomeric organization. Do not turn the archetype into a universal ATP-driven transporter.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: ligand-gated ion channel and solute carrier transporter; beta-barrel outer-membrane architecture differs.

evidence.location: Normal Function; Types; Structure; Resistance Due to Decreased Permeability

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: ligand-gated ion channel and solute carrier transporter; beta-barrel outer-membrane architecture differs.

records.name: Aggrecan proteoglycan monomer
records.scientific_description: Aggrecan has glycosaminoglycan side chains attached to a protein core.
records.design_instructions: Plan a flexible core with detachable brush-like side chains and a designated attachment region. Preserve chain/core separation for intact and fragmented states. A cartilage panel must assemble these with existing collagen and cell assets.
records.scientific_caveat: This is an aggrecan archetype, not the architecture of every proteoglycan; no quantitative stiffness follows from chain density in the icon.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: extracellular matrix mesh and collagen fibril; neither represents a single decorated proteoglycan.

evidence.location: Abstract; Structure of Aggrecan; Nanomechanics sections

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: extracellular matrix mesh and collagen fibril; neither represents a single decorated proteoglycan.

records.name: Membrane scaffold protein belt
records.scientific_description: Engineered scaffold proteins stabilize the edge of a nanodisc lipid bilayer.
records.design_instructions: Plan a reusable open/closed belt around a circular or elliptical membrane boundary, with lipid-facing inner edge and exposed outer edge. Build the disc from existing lipid bilayer components and this belt rather than baking a membrane protein into it.
records.scientific_caveat: Disc dimensions and belt stoichiometry depend on the scaffold construct. No single size is implied.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: coiled-coil protein and ring-shaped protein complex; a lipid-edge scaffold has a different assembly role.

evidence.location: Introductory description; Good Cholesterol; Exploring the Structure

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: coiled-coil protein and ring-shaped protein complex; a lipid-edge scaffold has a different assembly role.

records.name: G-quadruplex topology module
records.scientific_description: Guanine-rich nucleic acid can fold into quadruplex structures.
records.design_instructions: Plan a strand-followable stack of tetrad placeholders with connecting loops. Retain 5-prime and 3-prime anchors. Use a compact topology view and a simplified small-scale icon; reserve base and ion labels for a specified structure.
records.scientific_caveat: Loop topology and strand orientation are sequence dependent. A telomere need not be folded into this state.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: DNA double helix and telomere; neither conveys four-stranded folding.

evidence.location: Protecting the Ends; Add Six Bases, Repeat; Quadruplexes

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: DNA double helix and telomere; neither conveys four-stranded folding.

records.name: Four-way DNA junction topology module
records.scientific_description: Holliday junctions connect four DNA arms; their conformation depends on sequence and conditions.
records.design_instructions: Plan four duplex arms with continuous colored strand paths through the junction. Include an explanatory open layout and a compact stacked arrangement. Crossing strands must remain traceable and must not appear severed.
records.scientific_caveat: Open layout is an explanatory design choice. The cited deposition directly supports a stacked-X conformation, not a universal angle.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: replication fork has three arms; a four-way junction adds a different topology.

evidence.location: Primary Citation abstract; structure metadata

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: replication fork has three arms; a four-way junction adds a different topology.

records.name: Pericyte with vessel-facing processes
records.scientific_description: Pericytes are associated with the outside of capillary endothelium.
records.design_instructions: Plan an elongated nucleated cell whose processes can follow a vessel exterior. Provide a vessel-contact anchor and process handles. Keep the vessel itself separate and leave marker labels optional.
records.scientific_caveat: Shape varies by vascular bed. Positioning outside the endothelial lumen is the verified constraint; process lengths are schematic.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: smooth muscle cell and fibroblast; the vascular wrapping configuration should remain distinguishable.

evidence.location: Continuous; Fenestrated capillaries; Sinusoids

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: smooth muscle cell and fibroblast; the vascular wrapping configuration should remain distinguishable.

records.name: Paneth cell with apical granule compartment
records.scientific_description: Paneth cells occur at intestinal crypt bases and contain antimicrobial secretory granules.
records.design_instructions: Plan a crypt-compatible epithelial outline with a distinct granule-rich apical region and basal nucleus. Include explicit apical/basal anchors so the cell can be inserted among existing epithelial cells. Keep granules separate for a secretion scene.
records.scientific_caveat: Granule colors are design choices, not unstained biological colors. Do not identify all granular epithelial cells as Paneth cells.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: goblet cell has a mucus-filled apical cup; Paneth granules should not be drawn as that cup.

evidence.location: Structure; Epithelium and Villi; Crypts

records.deduplication_decision: Closest baseline: goblet cell has a mucus-filled apical cup; Paneth granules should not be drawn as that cup.

records.name: Type II pneumocyte with secretion anchors
records.scientific_description: Type II pneumocytes are comparatively compact alveolar epithelial cells that secrete surfactant.
records.design_instructions: Plan a compact cell cutaway with a nucleus, apical secretion positions and lateral junction anchors. Fit it as a discrete cell in an alveolar wall; expose an apical face toward airspace. Use library vesicles for secretion.
records.scientific_caveat: The verified distinction is compact secretory cell versus thin type I cell. Detailed lamellar-body ultrastructure remains outside this specification.
records.related_baseline: Closest baseline: generic epithelial cell; alveolar placement and secretion interfaces motivate this specialized cutaway.

records.name: Thylakoid electron-transfer map

records.name: Pollen tube guidance to an ovule

records.name: Bacterial sporulation stage sequence

records.name: Asymmetric yeast budding and separation
records.design_proposal: Arrange linked yeast instances across bud emergence, growth and separation; preserve mother/bud identity across panels.
records.required_verification: Verify nuclear segregation and cell-wall remodeling events for a chosen organism.

records.name: Biofilm dispersal versus growth
records.design_proposal: Reuse bacterial groups and extracellular matrix in two panels; release a subset into a separate planktonic lane.
records.required_verification: Verify dispersal triggers and matrix composition for a specified biofilm model.

records.name: Conjugative DNA transfer and establishment
records.design_proposal: Use the existing conjugation pair and a plasmid inset to distinguish donor DNA, transferred strand and recipient establishment.
records.required_verification: Verify strand processing, transfer direction and replication stages for a selected plasmid system.

records.name: Bacterial efflux versus reduced entry
records.design_proposal: Build matched cell-envelope panels separating outward active transport from inward permeability changes.
records.required_verification: Verify the chosen pump family; do not substitute an ABC transporter for every efflux mechanism.

records.name: Phage lytic and lysogenic decision diagram
records.design_proposal: Branch the existing phage/host context into replicated-particle production and integrated-genome maintenance states.
records.required_verification: Choose a temperate phage and verify integration, induction and lifecycle boundaries.

records.name: Antibody class-switch DNA rearrangement
records.design_proposal: Use a labeled DNA locus and a B-cell context, keeping variable-region identity separate from constant-region replacement.
records.required_verification: Verify switch-region topology and distinguish class switching from somatic hypermutation.

records.name: Germinal-center selection itinerary

records.name: Leukocyte rolling to arrest under flow

records.name: Efferocytosis recognition and resolution
records.design_proposal: Place apoptotic-body instances beside a macrophage, then use linked engulfment and post-engulfment annotation panels.
records.required_verification: Verify recognition bridges and downstream response; keep this distinct from microbial phagocytosis.

records.name: NK activating and inhibitory signal balance
records.design_proposal: Use an NK/target contact with independent activating and inhibitory receptor lanes and a configurable output annotation.

records.name: Innate-cell inflammasome and gasdermin output

records.name: ER protein quality-control routing

records.required_verification: Verify ER-associated degradation direction, membrane extraction and chaperone roles.

records.name: Organelle contact-site lipid exchange

records.name: Stress granule assembly and recovery

records.name: Receptor recycling versus lysosomal sorting
records.design_proposal: Split an internalized receptor lane into surface return and lysosomal delivery while preserving cargo identity.

records.name: Mitochondrial fission and fusion comparison
records.design_proposal: Use linked mitochondrion states with separate constriction and joining sequences; keep inner/outer membranes distinguishable.

records.name: Axonal conduction across myelin gaps

records.name: Astrocyte-neuron metabolic exchange

records.name: Glomerular filtration barrier layers

records.name: Bone remodeling coupling

records.name: Hepatic lobule directional flows

records.name: Transwell migration with counting endpoint
records.design_proposal: Place cells above a porous insert, directional cues below and migrated cells in a separately countable lower compartment.
records.required_verification: Verify assay configuration and distinguish migration from proliferation or differential survival.

records.name: Magnetic enrichment with retained and depleted fractions
records.design_proposal: Use antibody-bead-cell groups passing a magnetic column, retaining both output fractions with explicit labels.
records.required_verification: Verify positive versus negative selection and recovery sequence; purity is measured, not implied.

records.name: Organoid passage and recovery overview

records.required_verification: Choose an organoid system and verify whether fragmentation or dissociation is appropriate.

records.name: Perfused organ-on-chip barrier measurement

records.name: Spatial spot mixtures versus individual cells

records.required_verification: Verify platform resolution and capture model; do not label a multicell spot as a single cell.

records.name: Ambient RNA and multiplet quality-control panel

records.name: Chromatographic separation and fraction identity
